design.objective: Provide a project-scoped, independently maintained release calendar with member-authorized CRUD and responsive month presentation.
users: Project members viewing and maintaining their project's release arrangements.

requirements.statement: Add a project-detail release-calendar tab while preserving existing tab routes.
acceptance: Direct and interactive tab navigation load the calendar.

requirements.statement: Persist independent entries containing only title, release date, and remark.
acceptance: CRUD survives refresh and does not alter release-window data.
counterexample: Reading or writing configuration-management release windows.

requirements.statement: Authorize project members on the server for calendar reads and writes.
acceptance: Non-members and cross-tenant callers are denied.

requirements.statement: Use a desktop month calendar and a mobile date-grouped list.
acceptance: The specified mobile and desktop viewports have no page-level horizontal overflow.
counterexample: A desktop grid squeezed into the phone viewport.

requirements.statement: Restyle project tabs after the configuration-management release-window navigation.
acceptance: Existing tabs remain usable and theme-readable.
counterexample: Replacing the navigation with unrelated styling.

invariants: Server-side tenant, membership, entity, optimistic-lock, and audit controls apply.
constraints: Vue 3 and existing Element Plus/UI patterns.
Project system module owns the API and data.

selected_approach.name: Project-detail independent calendar tab
selected_approach.reason: Retains project context while separating release scheduling from project plans and configuration-management windows.

components.name: ProjectView
components.responsibility: Tab routing and responsive calendar interaction

interfaces.name: Project release calendar REST API
interfaces.contract: Month listing plus optimistic-lock CRUD within a project scope.

data_flows.input: Project member selects project tab and month
transitions: Server validates project membership and tenant
UI renders calendar or mobile list

error_handling.behavior: Deny on server and show no-permission state

security: Server-side membership, tenant and entity checks
performance: Load one month at a time
compatibility: Preserve existing project tabs and release-window behavior
operations: Additive migration and retained records on rollback

verification_strategy.signal: Existing and new tabs navigate correctly
verification_strategy.method: Browser regression at desktop and mobile.

verification_strategy.signal: Persisted CRUD and denied unauthorized writes

assumptions.text: Project member relationship grants calendar maintenance authority.
assumptions.basis: User stated all project people can edit.
assumptions.falsifier: Owner requires an additional role or permission boundary.
